name: Quell
long_description: Quell is an immersive fitness game where players get fit fighting their way through a fantasy world. Our low-cost wearable uses smart resistance bands to guide you through an exciting, effective combat workout at home. We’re Peloton meets gaming at 1/10th of the price
one_liner: Get fit fighting your way through a fantasy world.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: CEO of Quell. Ex-McKinsey consultant turned design engineer. Passionate about making boring things fun.

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio:
Quell Founder and COO. 
I like making products that improve people's health and wellbeing. Previously a Product Designer.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Founder & Business Director at Concept80 | Co-Founder & former CMO/COO at Quell | Start-Up Adviser at UCL & UBC | Ex-Red Bull --- 

I've founded businesses in the gaming, fitness and professional services sectors, with other start-up experience across fintech, sports retail and B2C/C2C marketplaces. Hosted a series of remote work/adventure retreats in 2016-20 for founders and Fortune 500 leadership teams based around philosophy of 'Development Through Adventure'. Love to ski, bike and kitesurf!

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I spent 10 years studying Materials Science at the University of Oxford, initially as an undergraduate, before building novel sensor technology from graphene and other 2D materials as a graduate student. Quell brings together my technical background and interests in gaming and fitness (although we still haven't worked out how to work graphene into this project...).
